   130→        var end = -1

   159→                                }

   161→                            }
   162→                        } else {

   164→                            logger.trace("LENGTH:{} / {}", length, readLength)

   166→                                break
   167→                            } else {

   172→                            }

   178→                            offsetAtt.setOffset(0, tokenLength)

   181→                        }

   183→                        bufferStart = 0
   184→                        chrCurrent = '\u0000'

   186→                    }

   191→                    val typePrev = typeCurrent

   210→                        // 모두 떨어뜨려서 한글분석을 거침

   279→                        entry = entry!!.next()
   280→                        continue
   281→                    }

   283→                    endOffset = correctOffset(baseOffset + entry!!.offset() + entry!!.column())
   284→                    tokenAtt.ref(buffer!!, entry!!.offset(), entry!!.column())
   285→                    tokenAtt.posTag(entry!!.posTag())
   286→                    offsetAtt.setOffset(startOffset, endOffset)
   287→                    logger.trace("TERM:{} / {}~{} / {} / {} / {}", tokenAtt.ref(), startOffset, endOffset, baseOffset, readLength, tokenAtt.posTag())
   288→                    if (exportTerm) {
   289→                        if (logger.isTraceEnabled) {
   290→                            logger.trace("{} / {}~{}", String(buffer!!, entry!!.offset(), entry!!.column()), entry!!.offset(), entry!!.column())
   291→                        }
   292→                        termAtt.copyBuffer(buffer, entry!!.offset(), entry!!.column())
   293→                    }
   294→                    val extPosition: Int
   295→                    var tempExtPosition = entry!!.offset() + entry!!.column()
   296→                    val prevOffset = entry!!.offset()
   297→                    entry = entry!!.next()

   299→                    while (entry != null) {
   300→                        if (entry!!.offset() < prevOffset) {
   301→                            entry = entry!!.next()
   302→                        } else {
   303→                            break
   304→                        }
   305→                    }
   306→
   307→                    if (entry == null) {

   310→                            if (tabularFull) {
   311→                                // TabularSize 를 넘어서 분석한 후 경우의 수
   312→                                // 1. 일반적으로 최종 단어와 이후 단어를 이어서 다시한번 단어분석 시도
   313→                                // 2. 분석된 단어길이가 tabularsize 와 같은경우 -> 그대로 출력 (Rule 에서 결합시도)
   314→                                logger.trace("CONTINUE-TERM:{}", tokenAtt.ref())

   320→                            }

   323→                                extLength = extractor!!.getTabularSize()
   324→                                tabularFull = true
   325→                            } else {
   326→                                tabularFull = false
   327→                            }

   334→                        }

    20→/**
    21→ * Indexer for migrating data from Fastcat search engine to Elasticsearch.
    22→ * Fetches data via HTTP and indexes into ES.
    23→ */
    24→class FastcatMigrateIndexer(
    25→    url: String,
    26→    start: Int,
    27→    length: Int,
    28→    path: String?,
    29→    enc: String?,
    30→    private val indexName: String,
    31→    private val flush: Int,
    32→    private val client: NodeClient?
    33→) : Thread() {
    34→
    35→    private val url: String
    36→    private val start: Int
    37→    private val length: Int
    38→    private val path: String?
    39→    private val enc: String?
    40→
    41→    @Volatile
    42→    private var running: Boolean = false
    43→    private var count: Int = 0
    44→
    45→    init {
    46→        this.url = url
    47→        this.start = if (start < 1) 1 else start
    48→        this.length = if (length < 10) 10 else length
    49→        this.path = path
    50→        this.enc = if (!path.isNullOrEmpty() && enc.isNullOrEmpty()) "utf-8" else enc
    51→    }
    52→
    53→    fun running(): Boolean = running
    54→
    55→    fun count(): Int = count
    56→
    57→    fun migrateFastcat() {
    58→        var con: HttpURLConnection? = null
    59→        var reader: BufferedReader? = null
    60→        var writer: BufferedWriter? = null
    61→        var builder: BulkRequestBuilder? = null
    62→        val time = System.currentTimeMillis()
    63→
    64→        try {
    65→            logger.trace("SEND REQUEST {}", url)
    66→            var total = start + length
    67→
    68→            if (!path.isNullOrEmpty()) {
    69→                val file = File(path)
    70→                if (file.parentFile?.exists() == true) {
    71→                    writer = BufferedWriter(OutputStreamWriter(FileOutputStream(file), enc))
    72→                }
    73→            }
    74→
    75→            if (client != null) {
    76→                builder = client.prepareBulk()
    77→            }
    78→
    79→            var sinx = start
    80→            while (sinx < total) {
    81→                @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
    82→                con = URL("$url&sn=$sinx&ln=$length").openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
    83→                con.requestMethod = "GET"
    84→                val responseCode = con.responseCode
    85→                logger.trace("RESPONSE:{}", responseCode)
    86→
    87→                if (responseCode == HttpURLConnection.HTTP_OK) {
    88→                    reader = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(con.inputStream))
    89→                    val tokener = JSONTokener(reader)
    90→                    val resp = JSONObject(tokener)
    91→                    total = resp.optInt("total_count", total)
    92→                    val fieldNames = resp.optJSONArray("fieldname_list")?.toList() ?: emptyList<Any>()
    93→                    val list = resp.optJSONArray("result")

    97→                            val row = list.optJSONObject(rinx)
    98→

   100→                                for (key in fieldNames) {
   101→                                    val keyStr = key.toString()
   102→                                    val value = row.getString(keyStr).replace(Regex("[\t\r\n\u0000]"), " ")
   103→                                    w.append("[%").append(keyStr).append("%]").append(value)
   104→                                }
   105→                                w.append(NEWLINE)
   106→                            }
   107→
   108→                            builder?.let { b ->
   109→                                b.add(client!!.prepareIndex(indexName).setSource(filterMap(row.toMap())))

   111→                                    b.execute().actionGet()
   112→                                    builder = client.prepareBulk()
   113→                                }
   114→                                if (count > 0 && count % 100000 == 0) {
   115→                                    logger.debug("{} ROWS FLUSHED! in {}ms", count, System.currentTimeMillis() - time)
   116→                                }
   117→                            }
   118→                            count++
   119→                        }
   120→                    }
   121→                }
   122→                sinx += length
   123→            }
   124→
   125→            builder?.execute()?.actionGet()

   131→            try { reader?.close() } catch (_: Exception) { }
   132→        }

   135→    @Throws(Exception::class)
   136→    private fun filterMap(map: Map<String, Any>): MutableMap<String, Any?> {

   140→        }

   142→    }

   145→    private fun fieldValue(source: MutableMap<String, Any?>, key: String, value: String) {
   146→        when {
   147→            key.isEmpty() -> { }
   148→            key == "REGISTERDATE" -> {
   149→                if (value.isNotEmpty()) {

   152→                }
   153→            }
   154→            else -> source[key] = value
   155→        }
   156→        logger.trace("ROW:{} / {}", key, value)
   157→    }

   161→        count = 0
   162→        migrateFastcat()

   164→    }
